senses.gloss: m. (בְּצַע) piece, morsel, crumb.—Pl. בִּיצּוּעִין, בִּיצּוּעֵי, בִּיצְעֵי.
units: <cite ref="Onkelos Leviticus 2:6">Targ. O. Lev. II, 6</cite>; a. e.—
<cite ref="Shabbat 140b:8">Sabb. 140ᵇ</cite> <he>לא ליבצע ב׳</he> he must not eat it by morsels (but enough at a time).
<cite ref="Sukkah 26a:10">Succ. 26ᵃ</cite> <he>תרתי או תלת ביצעי</he> Ms. M. (ed. <he>ביעי</he>, v. Rashi a. l.) two or three morsels.
